note: Preregistered non-inferiority margins (fractions) for analyze.ts --margins. Each is the per-harness maximum of power.ts --from-analysis on the set L pilot (pilot-L analysis.json) at 80% power when the true harm is zero, one-sided 2.5%, with floors of 0.02 (wrong skill) and 0.035 (no-skill open). A margin marked exact-bound came from zero discordant pilot pairs, where power.ts prints its exact-bound floor of 3.0 points.
